correctness.rationale: The rank-one-adjugate dichotomy exhausts every singular point. The irreducible product of rank-r isotropic quadrics and exact \(O(r)\) fiber count establish \(\dim D_n=N-4\). Generic noncontainment proves exactly \(n+1\) irreducible components. Invertible-block Schur complements give node local rings along each zero-row stratum. An explicit Gram witness verifies rank three of the normal deformation map along \(D_n\), hence a second generic quadratic node. Codimension and Serre give normality. Standalone checker verified 36 exact Jacobian specializations plus four each of Schur, Gram-rank and normal-independence identities; these are finite support, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: This supplies a complete reduced singular-component classification for the natural infinite family of A-discriminants dual to second hypersimplices, including the explicit \(n+1\) count, dimensions, projective normality and two distinct generic formal singularity types. The sharp change from the known \(n=4\) splitting is geometric, and the generic models motivate further intersection, resolution and characteristic-class studies. It is not a one-off computation or mere normalization check.
